|game_text=Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown.' During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play [[Desperate Tactics]], [[Lucky Shot (V){{!}}Lucky Shot]], [[On Target]], [[Rapid Fire]], or [[Steady Aim]], may draw top card from Reserve Deck. May not be suspended. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-81-Maneuvering_Flaps_Nick_Of_Time-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when ‘thrown.’ During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. May not be suspended. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 26). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) removed “May not be suspended.” (the card list writes the ▲ and Immune to Alter icons out in words): “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown.' During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to take its matching pilot character (or vice versa) from Reserve Deck and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_82-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
